discrepancies.name: Token Accounting Contradiction
discrepancies.narrative_claim: Narrative claimed prompts fit inside 8192 context window (~2.9k-4.3k tokens).
discrepancies.root_cause: The scratch measurement script evaluated an unbudgeted raw canonical evidence dump without calling TokenBudgetService.budget_prompt().
discrepancies.corrected_truth: Calling TokenBudgetService.budget_prompt() applies deterministic compaction. Mode A prompts range from 2,262 to 5,874 tokens; Mode B prompts range from 2,454 to 6,680 tokens. 100% (20 of 20) fit within the 7,424-token input budget.

discrepancies.name: Evidence Hash Mismatches Across Manifests
discrepancies.manifest_evidence: FROZEN_COHORT_MANIFEST.json and EVIDENCE_HASH_MANIFEST.json differed from REQUEST_RESPONSE_HASH_MANIFEST.json.
discrepancies.root_cause: Serialization formatting difference (json.dumps with compact separators=(',', ':') vs default spaces) and inclusion/exclusion of event_type in rule_spec.
discrepancies.corrected_truth: Data in SQLite was identical. Enforced strict deterministic compact UTF-8 JSON hashing standard.

discrepancies.name: Incident Entity Identity Mismatches
discrepancies.narrative_claim: Priority incidents described as net.exe, whoami.exe, and 21447_610850.xlsx.
discrepancies.database_truth: Neither net.exe, whoami.exe, nor 21447_610850.xlsx exist in the database. 9 CrowdStrike incidents are UltraViewer_Service.exe, 1 is MEGAsync.exe; Prisma incidents are update.exe, review.es.system.js, jquery.knob.js, etc.
discrepancies.root_cause: Narrative documentation copied legacy synthetic test labels instead of querying the authoritative SQLite database.
discrepancies.corrected_truth: All incident identities reconciled directly from SQLite rawEvents.

discrepancies.name: Neutral Prompt Hash Normalization
discrepancies.manifest_evidence: Discrepancy between raw file hash and Python string hash.
discrepancies.root_cause: Windows CRLF newlines (459915e1...) vs LF-normalized string (eed5c3be...).
discrepancies.corrected_truth: Both hashes documented; eed5c3be... is the canonical LF execution hash.

discrepancies.name: Deployment & Git SHA Lineage Discrepancy
discrepancies.manifest_evidence: Server 1 at 8770e071... while GitHub latest was 03bd11ae...
discrepancies.root_cause: Follow-up commit 03bd11ae... contained only documentation manifests; zero application code drifted.
discrepancies.corrected_truth: Server 1 is running 100% of the verified application code from 8770e071...
